parameters.formDescription: One keyword per submission. This opens a brief issue on AntByteLabs/a2z-skills. Nothing is published by this form.

values.fieldLabel: What the reader is trying to do

parameters.jsCode:
// Build the issue body in the same shape as the repo's post-brief template.
const f = $input.first().json;
const slug = String(f.Keyword || '')
  .toLowerCase()
  .normalize('NFKD')
  .replace(/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g, '')
  .trim()
  .replace(/\s+/g, '-');

const needsTest = ['how-to', 'fix', 'review'].includes(f.Type);

const body = [
  `**Keyword:** ${f.Keyword}`,
  `**Pillar:** ${f.Pillar}`,
  `**Type:** ${f.Type}`,
  '',
  '### What the reader is trying to do',
  f['What the reader is trying to do'],
  '',
  '### What the top results miss',
  f['What the top results miss'],
  '',
  `**Test setup:** ${f['Test setup needed'] || 'not given'}`,
  `**Money page:** ${f['Money page to link'] || 'none'}`,
  '',
  '### Scaffold',
  '```bash',
  `npm run new -- "${f.Keyword}" --type ${f.Type} --pillar ${f.Pillar}`,
  '```',
  '',
  '### Before closing',
  needsTest
    ? '- [ ] Tested on a real machine, with versions, device and every error recorded'
    : '- [ ] Sources checked and linked (this type is not hands-on)',
  '- [ ] Drafted, then run through /humanizer',
  '- [ ] Edited by a person',
  '- [ ] npm run validate passes',
  '- [ ] Preview URL read on a phone',
  '- [ ] Two or three inbound links added from older posts',
  '',
  `_Filed from the n8n brief form at ${new Date().toISOString()}._`,
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { title: `Post: ${f.Keyword}`, body, slug, pillar: f.Pillar, type: f.Type } }];
